title: The Home
objectives: Recognize, pronounce, and trace basic letter sounds and common home-related vocabulary
Demonstrate polite expressions and greetings in home settings
Identify tools and objects in the home through words, images, and actions
Decode and spell monosyllabic words connected to routines and spaces
Compose short oral and written phrases introducing people and places at home
Participate in storytelling, singing, and simple role-play about life at home
Create a strip with a drawing of their home and three labeled items
project_steps: Create a strip with a drawing of their home and three labeled items
Add a greeting phrase and polite expression
Include a short sentence introducing one family member
Perform a rhyme or song related to life at home

title: The Village/Town
objectives: Recognize common places, people, and routines in the village or town
Use polite expressions to greet and describe people and places in the community
Read and pronounce simple words related to village and town life
Identify and write names and locations using basic sentence structure
Participate in songs, stories, rhymes, and dialogue connected to daily community life
Create a strip showing 3 places in their village/town with drawings and labels
Add short phrases describing one person and place
project_steps: Create a strip showing 3 places in their village/town with drawings and labels
Add short phrases describing one person and place
Include a polite greeting or request related to the community
Recite a rhyme or short chant about daily life in the village or town

title: The School
objectives: Identify common objects, people, and places within the school environment
Use greetings and polite phrases in classroom situations
Decode and spell monosyllabic and simple multisyllabic school-related words
Write short descriptive and instructional sentences related to school routines
Apply grammar features such as regular verbs, adjectives, and simple sentence structure
Participate in songs, chants, sketches, and short dialogues linked to school life
Create a visual strip showing three classroom or school scenes
project_steps: Create a visual strip showing three classroom or school scenes
Include labels and short phrases for school places, actions, and people
Add one instructional or greeting phrase used at school
Perform a short rhyme or chant describing a school routine

title: Occupations
objectives: Identify common jobs, tools, and responsibilities in the community
Use polite language and correct sentence structure to describe work routines
Read and write monosyllabic and simple multisyllabic job-related words
Apply grammar features such as noun-verb agreement, pronouns, and adjectives
Participate in role-play, chants, songs, and descriptive writing based on community work
Create a visual strip featuring drawings and labels of two occupations
Include a short greeting and one action sentence for each job
project_steps: Create a visual strip featuring drawings and labels of two occupations
Include a short greeting and one action sentence for each job
Add one polite request or work-related phrase
Perform a chant, rhyme, or short scene about people and the work they do

title: Travelling
objectives: Recognize common forms of transport and travel-related vocabulary
Use directional words, location prepositions, and polite expressions when speaking about movement
Read, spell, and segment simple travel words and safety expressions
Write short instructions and descriptive phrases about going from place to place
Apply grammar such as regular verbs, simple sentence types, and prepositions of location and movement
Engage in role-play, chants, and conversations about safe and polite travel
Create a strip with drawings of two travel methods and labels
project_steps: Create a strip with drawings of two travel methods and labels
Add one directional phrase and one polite request related to travel
Include one chant or short rhyme about movement or safety
Present the strip through speech or a short dramatized scene

title: Health
objectives: Identify good hygiene habits, body parts, and personal care items
Demonstrate polite responses, greetings, and health-related instructions
Read and write simple health vocabulary and descriptive phrases
Apply grammar structures including adjectives, regular verbs, and prepositions
Segment and spell monosyllabic and multisyllabic health-related words
Participate in chants, sketches, and rhymes about health and well-being
Create a strip with drawings of two hygiene or health tools and their labels
project_steps: Create a strip with drawings of two hygiene or health tools and their labels
Include a polite health request or instruction
Add one short chant, rhyme, or sentence promoting good habits
Present the strip orally, using vocabulary from the theme

title: Games
objectives: Identify common games and play tools used indoors and outdoors
Use polite expressions and instructions when participating in games
Read and write simple words, phrases, and rules related to play
Apply grammar features including verbs, prepositions, and conjunctions
Decode, spell, and segment play-related vocabulary
Participate in rhymes, dialogues, sketches, and structured play activities
Create a strip with drawings and labels of one indoor and one outdoor game
project_steps: Create a strip with drawings and labels of one indoor and one outdoor game
Include short sentences describing each game and its tools
Add one polite phrase or instruction used during play
Perform a rhyme or short scene that reflects the spirit of friendly play

title: Communication
objectives: Identify common communication methods and tools (verbal, non-verbal, digital, and traditional)
Use appropriate greetings, expressions, and descriptive vocabulary during communication
Read, write, and decode basic words related to expressing ideas, messages, and feelings
Apply grammar structures including sentence types, pronouns, and punctuation for clarity
Build and spell words related to talking, asking, and sharing information
Engage in dialogue, chant, storytelling, and role-play about exchanging messages and feelings
Create a strip showing two forms of communication (e.g., talking and messaging) with drawings and labels
project_steps: Create a strip showing two forms of communication (e.g., talking and messaging) with drawings and labels
Add greeting and expression phrases for sharing ideas politely
Include one chant or short role-play about giving and receiving a message
Present the strip with clear explanation and oral performance
